title: Set up Google Search Console for cubric.studio
description: Option 1 from MPI-1288. Add cubric.studio to Google Search Console as a Domain property, verified by a DNS TXT record on Cloudflare (the zone already lives there, DNS only, site served by GitHub Pages). No script on the site, nothing on visitors, so the 'No analytics' footer promise stays true. Steps: Fabio signs in to Search Console with his Google account and adds the domain property; it shows a google-site-verification TXT value; add that TXT record at the cubric.studio apex in Cloudflare (Fabio, or an agent if a Cloudflare API token exists); press Verify. Then submit the sitemap if the site has one (check the Cubric Studio (Website) repo for sitemap.xml; add one if missing, listing the landing pages incl. local-ai-image-generator and uncensored-ai-image-generator). Data starts from verification day, not before. Done = property verified, sitemap submitted, and a first look at Queries and Pages after ~3 days recorded on MPI-1288.
